{"timeline":[{"headline":"Film Release","text":"Deep Blue Sea was released in theaters on July 28, 1999. It is a science fiction horror film directed by Renny Harlin.","date":"1999-07-28"},{"headline":"Film Setting and Plot","text":"The film is set in an isolated underwater facility where a team of scientists conducts research on mako sharks to help fight Alzheimer's disease. The plot follows the chaos that ensues when genetically engineered sharks go on a rampage and flood the facility.","date":"1999"},{"headline":"Cast and Characters","text":"The film stars Saffron Burrows, Thomas Jane, Samuel L. Jackson, Michael Rapaport, and LL Cool J. Each actor plays a significant role in the unfolding drama within the underwater facility.","date":"1999"},{"headline":"Film Series","text":"Deep Blue Sea is the first film in the film series of the same name. It set the stage for subsequent films that explore similar themes of genetic engineering and survival against predatory threats.","date":"1999"}]}

{"timeline":[{"headline":"Birth of Korra","text":"Korra was born in the Southern Water Tribe to Tonraq and Senna.","date":"-0001"},{"headline":"Discovery as the Avatar","text":"At the age of four, Korra discovered she was the Avatar when she demonstrated her ability to bend water, earth, and fire.","date":"0003"},{"headline":"Training with Katara","text":"Korra began her waterbending training with Katara, a renowned waterbender and the wife of Avatar Aang.","date":"0003"},{"headline":"Move to Republic City","text":"Korra moved to Republic City to complete her airbending training under Tenzin, the son of Avatar Aang.","date":"0017"},{"headline":"Confrontation with Amon","text":"Korra faced Amon, the leader of the Equalists, who sought to eliminate bending from the world.","date":"0017"},{"headline":"Defeat of Amon","text":"Korra defeated Amon, restoring balance to Republic City and regaining her bending abilities with the help of Avatar Aang's spirit.","date":"0017"},{"headline":"Battle with Unalaq and Vaatu","text":"Korra battled her uncle Unalaq and the dark spirit Vaatu, preventing them from plunging the world into darkness.","date":"0018"},{"headline":"Creation of the Spirit Portals","text":"Korra decided to keep the spirit portals open, allowing humans and spirits to coexist.","date":"0018"},{"headline":"Confrontation with Zaheer","text":"Korra faced Zaheer, the leader of the Red Lotus, who sought to overthrow world governments and eliminate the Avatar.","date":"0019"},{"headline":"Recovery from Poisoning","text":"After being poisoned by Zaheer, Korra spent several years recovering and regaining her strength.","date":"0020"},{"headline":"Battle with Kuvira","text":"Korra confronted Kuvira, who attempted to conquer the Earth Kingdom and Republic City with her army and a giant mecha suit.","date":"0022"},{"headline":"Journey to the Spirit World with Asami","text":"Korra and Asami Sato embarked on a journey to the Spirit World together, marking the beginning of their romantic relationship.","date":"0022"}]}

{"timeline":[{"headline":"Founding of Corpus Christi","text":"Corpus Christi was founded in 1839 by Colonel Henry Lawrence Kinney as a trading post to sell supplies to a Mexican revolutionary army camped nearby.","date":"1839"},{"headline":"Incorporation as a City","text":"Corpus Christi was incorporated as a city in 1852, establishing its municipal government and formalizing its status as an urban area.","date":"1852"},{"headline":"Hurricane of 1919","text":"On September 14, 1919, a devastating hurricane struck Corpus Christi, causing significant damage and loss of life. This event led to the construction of a protective seawall.","date":"1919-09-14"},{"headline":"Naval Air Station Corpus Christi Established","text":"In 1941, the Naval Air Station Corpus Christi was established, significantly contributing to the local economy and playing a crucial role during World War II.","date":"1941"},{"headline":"Hurricane Celia","text":"On August 3, 1970, Hurricane Celia hit Corpus Christi, causing extensive damage to the city and resulting in numerous casualties.","date":"1970-08-03"},{"headline":"Corpus Christi Bayfront Development","text":"In the late 20th century, significant development occurred along the Corpus Christi Bayfront, enhancing the city's tourism and economic growth.","date":"1980s"},{"headline":"Hurricane Harvey","text":"In August 2017, Hurricane Harvey impacted Corpus Christi, causing widespread damage and prompting significant recovery and rebuilding efforts.","date":"2017-08"}]}

{"timeline":[{"headline":"Formation of Mount Shasta","text":"Mount Shasta began forming about 593,000 years ago. It is a potentially active stratovolcano located at the southern end of the Cascade Range in Siskiyou County, California.","date":"-591000"},{"headline":"Last Eruption","text":"The last known eruption of Mount Shasta occurred around 1786. It is considered potentially active, with the most recent activity being observed in the late 18th century.","date":"1786"},{"headline":"Mount Shasta in Modern Times","text":"Mount Shasta is part of the Shasta–Trinity National Forest and is a popular destination for hiking, climbing, and skiing. It stands at an elevation of 14,179 feet, making it the second-highest peak in the Cascades and the fifth-highest in California.","date":"2023"}]}

{"timeline":[{"headline":"Creation of Thousand Island Dressing","text":"Thousand Island dressing is believed to have been created in the early 20th century. {"timeline":[{"headline":"Discovery and Development","text":"Fluconazole was developed by Pfizer in the late 1970s and early 1980s.
